See also: Hélice

French

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

Learned borrowing from Latin helix, itself borrowed from Ancient Greek ἕλιξ (hélix).

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • (mute h) IPA(key): /e.lis/
  • Audio:(file)
  • Audio (France (Somain)):(file)

Noun

[edit]

hélice f (plural hélices)

  1. helix (blade)
  2. propeller
  3. (geometry) helix
  4. (chemistry) helix

Related terms

[edit]
  • hélicoïde
  • hélicoïdal

Further reading

[edit]
  • “hélice”, in Trésor de la langue française informatisé [Digitized Treasury of the French Language], 2012

Galician

[edit]

Noun

[edit]

hélice f (plural hélices)

  1. helix

Portuguese

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

Borrowed from Latin helīcem, from Ancient Greek ἕλῑξ (hélīx, “spiral”).

Pronunciation

[edit]
 
  • (Brazil) IPA(key): /ˈɛ.li.si/
  • (Brazil) IPA(key): /ˈɛ.li.si/
    • (Southern Brazil) IPA(key): /ˈɛ.li.se/
  • (Portugal) IPA(key): /ˈɛ.li.sɨ/

  • Rhymes: (Brazil) -ɛlisi, (Portugal) -ɛlisɨ
  • Hyphenation: hé‧li‧ce

Noun

[edit]

hélice f (plural hélices)

  1. a rotating propeller, such as a ship’s screw or a helicopter’s rotor

Descendants

[edit]
  • → Tetum: élise

Noun

[edit]

hélice m (plural hélices)

  1. alternative form of hélix

Further reading

[edit]
  • “hélice”, in Dicionário Aulete Digital (in Portuguese), Rio de Janeiro: Lexikon Editora Digital, 2008–2026
  • “hélice”, in Dicionário infopédia da Lingua Portuguesa (in Portuguese), Porto: Porto Editora, 2003–2026
  • “hélice”, in Michaelis Dicionário Brasileiro da Língua Portuguesa (in Portuguese), São Paulo: Editora Melhoramentos, 2015–2026, →ISBN
  • “hélice”, in Dicionário Priberam da Língua Portuguesa (in Portuguese), Lisbon: Priberam, 2008–2026

Etymology

[edit]

Borrowed from Latin helīcem, from Ancient Greek ἕλῑξ (hélīx, “spiral”).

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): /ˈeliθe/ [ˈe.li.θe] (Equatorial Guinea, Spain)
  • IPA(key): /ˈelise/ [ˈe.li.se] (Latin America, Philippines)
  • Rhymes: -eliθe (Equatorial Guinea, Spain)
  • Rhymes: -elise (Latin America, Philippines)
  • Syllabification: hé‧li‧ce

Noun

[edit]

hélice f (plural hélices)

  1. helix
  2. (geometry, anatomy) helix
  3. propeller

Derived terms

[edit]
  • doble hélice

Related terms

[edit]
  • helicoidal
  • helicoide

Descendants

[edit]
  • → Cebuano: elise (“propeller”)
  • → Tagalog: elise (“propeller”)

Further reading

[edit]
  • “hélice”, in Diccionario de la lengua española [Dictionary of the Spanish Language] (in Spanish), online version 23.8.1, Royal Spanish Academy [Spanish: Real Academia Española], 15 December 2025
